summary: Round 2 (corrective) for pull request https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1035 after review 5191040117 requested changes. Code commit 98c5ebf21c8e2886da1928e2189bb3f95ea7ba7d, on top of the reviewer's locally committed handoff 5a9e1de31b76 (carried by this push, untouched), routes every `push-main` failure through `fail_outstanding`: a failing `git fetch origin main` now fails with the release-succeeded message and summary; the resolvable conflict shape is exactly the manifest AND the file still present on main (`git cat-file -e HEAD:<manifest>`), so a modify/delete conflict aborts and fails naming the path; the jq rewrite lands via a temp file and the whole resolution is one guarded list that aborts the rebase on any failure. The four minors are applied (header enumerates the promise; both `rebase --abort` calls and the cat-file probe silenced; hermetic git config in the test; Case 1 asserts main's other manifest edit survives). Test: `Results: 33 passed, 0 failed` (was 22; the extended test against the round-1 script gave `27 passed, 6 failed`, exactly the reviewer's two reproductions). Tests run 34765902884 at 98c5ebf2.

Gate `[ "$conflicted" != "$manifest" ] || ! git cat-file -e "HEAD:$manifest" 2>/dev/null`; abort message adds 'with the file still present on main'; jq output via `$manifest.tmp` + mv; show|jq, mv, git add, GIT_EDITOR=true rebase --continue in one guarded `if ! { … }` that rm -f's the temp, aborts the rebase, and calls fail_outstanding. New Case 6 (main deleted packages/pkg): non-zero exit, `::error::…conflicts in: packages/pkg/package.json.`, rebase aborted, manifest intact at 1.0.1, origin/main untouched.
Header names the deleted-on-main case as a real divergence and enumerates the failure kinds the promise covers; nothing narrowed because every path is now routed.

Both `git rebase --abort` calls are `2>/dev/null || true`; the cat-file probe is silenced too (it prints `fatal: path … exists on disk, but not in 'HEAD'` on the modify/delete path). By hand: 0 `fatal:` lines before the ::error::.
`export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1` after `set -euo pipefail`, with a comment naming the keys fenced off.
Case 1: clone a's bump also sets `.description = "set on main by a"`, asserted on origin/main after push-main; a REBASE_HEAD: regression fails it.

trickyParts: `git cat-file -e HEAD:<path>` prints `fatal: path … exists on disk, but not in 'HEAD'` on stderr when the path is absent from HEAD but present in the working tree (the modify/delete shape); it needs `2>/dev/null` or the spurious fatal precedes the ::error:: line — the same class as the reviewer's `rebase --abort` minor.

Inside the guarded `if ! { …; }` list under `set -e`, a failing pipeline member does not exit the script (the list is a condition); the rm -f / rebase --abort / fail_outstanding branch runs. Verified with the jq shim.

The opposite modify/delete shape — the bump commit deleting the manifest while main modified it — is not guarded (HEAD:manifest exists, so the resolver would recreate the file with main's content and the released version). It is unreachable: `release-push.sh tag` stages the manifest the version step just wrote, so the bump commit is always a modification. Named here rather than coded; a `git cat-file -e REBASE_HEAD:$manifest` check would be the one-line guard if that ever changes.
